description: Evidence-based physical validation rubric for GeoTaichi model-agent reviews.

execution_integrity.description: The run completed with finite state, no capacity overflow, and a valid solver/timestep state.

contract_observable.description: The model contract's falsifiable observable was checked against an expected value, range, or trend.

physical_invariants.description: At least one solver-specific conservation, equilibrium, contact, or convergence requirement passed.

reproducibility.description: The command, effective backend, precision, and reduced/production status were recorded.

check_kinds.contract_observable: Contract-selected analytical, benchmark, or bounded-trend observable.
check_kinds.analytical: Comparison with an analytical value or curve.
check_kinds.benchmark: Comparison with a maintained or published benchmark.
check_kinds.mass_balance: Mass conservation residual or relative drift.
check_kinds.volume_balance: Volume conservation residual or relative drift.
check_kinds.energy_balance: Conservative energy balance or justified dissipative inequality.
check_kinds.force_balance: Static or dynamic resultant force/moment balance.
check_kinds.contact_gap: Non-penetration or bounded signed contact gap.
check_kinds.penetration: Maximum penetration relative to an explicit allowed scale.
check_kinds.convergence: Nonlinear, linear, or refinement convergence requirement.
check_kinds.derivative_consistency: Finite-difference residual, tangent, or Hessian consistency.
check_kinds.mesh_quality: Positive element measures, quality metric bounds, consistent orientation, and a stable first solver step for generated meshes.
